# opensource.wrikka.com

> Documentation hub for all wrikka collections.

## Rust Packages

- [@wrikka/opensource-wrikka-com](/docs/rust-packages/root-package-json.md): 
- [rust-packages](/docs/rust-packages/root-cargo.md): Cargo workspace root for rust-packages

## Bun Packages

- [@wrikka/bun-packages](/docs/bun-packages/root-package-json.md): Bun packages monorepo for Wrikka
- [@wrikka/bench-deps](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-bench-deps-package-npm.md): Benchmark and compare dependencies with detailed metrics
- [@wrikka/check-quality](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-check-quality-package-npm.md): Comprehensive code quality toolkit - linting, formatting, analysis, and unused file detection
- [@wrikka/create-skills](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-create-skills-package-npm.md): Devin skill orchestration CLI - run, call, spawn, delegate, and invoke
- [@wrikka/dotfile-manager](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-dotfile-manager-package-npm.md): A simple dotfiles manager inspired by chezmoi
- [@wrikka/generate](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-generate-package-npm.md): Generate and improve features — template generator and improve tools
- [@wrikka/release](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-release-package-npm.md): Modern release automation tool with integrated changelog generation
- [@wrikka/report-cli](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-report-cli-package-npm.md): Universal report generator CLI with pluggable templates and output formats
- [@wrikka/task-manager](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-task-manager-package-npm.md): Task management tool for development workflows
- [@wrikka/template-generator](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-template-generator-package-npm.md): Fast, type-safe template generator with Bun native template engine
- [@wrikka/test](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-test-package-npm.md): Fast test framework with Bun native performance and Clean Architecture
- [@wrikka/use-scripts](/docs/bun-packages/apps-cli-use-scripts-package-npm.md): Functional script generation library with AST manipulation and beautiful reporting
- [@wrikka/github-bot](/docs/bun-packages/apps-services-github-bot-package-npm.md): GitHub App bot for dependency/version review - extracted from wgithub-bot app
- [@wrikka/bench](/docs/bun-packages/apps-toolkits-bench-package-npm.md): High-performance benchmarking library - extracted from wbench app
- [@wrikka/create-cli](/docs/bun-packages/apps-toolkits-create-cli-package-npm.md): Create CLI - Unified terminal prompt, UI, TUI framework, CLI framework, and data display utilities
- [@wrikka/cloud](/docs/bun-packages/apps-web-cloud-package-npm.md): Wrikka cloud platform dashboard
- [@wrikka/create-docs](/docs/bun-packages/apps-web-create-docs-package-npm.md): Vite plugin for documentation sites built on Functional Clean Architecture with SolidJS support
- [web-inspector-example](/docs/bun-packages/apps-web-web-inspector-examples-vite-package-npm.md): web-inspector-example npm workspace at apps/web/web-inspector/examples/vite/package.json
- [@wrikka/web-inspector](/docs/bun-packages/apps-web-web-inspector-package-npm.md): @wrikka/web-inspector npm workspace at apps/web/web-inspector/package.json
- [@wrikka/analytics](/docs/bun-packages/packages-analytics-package-npm.md): Product and usage analytics
- [@wrikka/animation](/docs/bun-packages/packages-animation-package-npm.md): Fast, lightweight JavaScript animation library with Clean Architecture
- [@wrikka/app-router](/docs/bun-packages/packages-app-router-package-npm.md): @wrikka/app-router npm workspace at packages/app-router/package.json
- [@wrikka/chart](/docs/bun-packages/packages-chart-package-npm.md): Modern visualization library for SolidJS with Clean Architecture - Production-ready chart components
- [@wrikka/composables](/docs/bun-packages/packages-composables-package-npm.md): Wrikka Composables - SolidJS composables with Clean Architecture
- [@solidjs/devtools](/docs/bun-packages/packages-devtools-package-npm.md): @solidjs/devtools npm workspace at packages/devtools/package.json
- [@wrikka/graph](/docs/bun-packages/packages-graph-package-npm.md): A graph visualization module with Clean Architecture for SolidJS
- [@wrikka/integrations](/docs/bun-packages/packages-integrations-package-npm.md): Integration adapters for Wrikka (Stripe, GitHub, Supabase, Cloudflare)
- [@wrikka/notification](/docs/bun-packages/packages-notification-package-npm.md): Notification infrastructure inspired by Novu
- [@wrikka/query](/docs/bun-packages/packages-query-package-npm.md): Fine-grained reactive data fetching and cache management for SolidJS with Clean Architecture
- [@wrikka/stores](/docs/bun-packages/packages-stores-package-npm.md): Clean Architecture state management for SolidJS with time-travel, persistence, and validation
- [@wrikka/utils](/docs/bun-packages/packages-utils-package-npm.md): Consolidated utility packages for Wrikka projects
- [@wrikka/web-server](/docs/bun-packages/packages-web-server-package-npm.md): Production-ready web server library with file-system routing, AOT compilation, and universal runtime support built on Bun and Web Standards
